title: Spiral of Forgotten Words
description: A surreal painting depicts a massive swirling vortex in the night sky containing a white dragon, floating skulls, infinity symbols, and two silhouetted figures. In the foreground, a stone ruin is covered with scattered handwritten letters, white flowers, and a woman's hand with bright green nails and multiple rings reaching toward the papers.
